lions-mane-tincture.name: Lion's Mane Double Extract 30ml
lions-mane-tincture.description: Boost your mental clarity and focus. Our Lion's Mane (Hericium erinaceus) tincture is ideal for work, study, and creativity.
lions-mane-tincture.habitat: Grows mainly on dead or dying hardwood trees such as oak, beech, and maple.
lions-mane-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) once or twice daily. Can be mixed with your favorite beverage.

cordyceps-tincture.name: Cordyceps double extract 30ml
cordyceps-tincture.description: Increase your energy and physical endurance. Cordyceps (Cordyceps militaris) is the perfect ally for athletes and people with an active lifestyle.
cordyceps-tincture.habitat: Originally found at high altitudes in the Himalayas, now sustainably cultivated on organic substrates.
cordyceps-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) in the morning or before physical activity.

reishi-tincture.name: Reishi double extract 30ml
reishi-tincture.description: Find your center and calm your mind. Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum), known as the 'mushroom of immortality', is an adaptogen that helps manage stress.
reishi-tincture.habitat: Grows at the base and stumps of deciduous trees, especially maple.
reishi-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) in the afternoon or evening to help you relax.

3-product-bundle.name: 3-Product Bundle
3-product-bundle.description: The most complete bundle. Includes Lion's Mane for focus, Cordyceps for energy, and Reishi for stress relief and rest.
3-product-bundle.howToUse: Take Cordyceps and Lion's Mane in the morning, and Reishi at night.

adaptogenic-coffee.name: Adaptogenic Coffee
adaptogenic-coffee.description: Start your day with energy and focus. Our organic coffee is enriched with Lion's Mane and Cordyceps for superior mental and physical performance.
adaptogenic-coffee.habitat: Coffee grown in the highlands combined with cultivated mushrooms.
adaptogenic-coffee.howToUse: Brew a cup as you would with your regular coffee.

mind-body-bundle.name: Wellness Bundle
mind-body-bundle.description: The ultimate bundle for optimal performance. Combines the mental clarity of Lion's Mane with the physical energy of Cordyceps.
mind-body-bundle.howToUse: Take Cordyceps in the morning and Lion's Mane when you need a cognitive boost.

calm-defense-bundle.name: Calm & Defense Bundle
calm-defense-bundle.description: Strengthen your body and calm your mind. Reishi helps you manage stress while Turkey Tail reinforces your immune system.
calm-defense-bundle.howToUse: Take Turkey Tail in the morning and Reishi in the afternoon/evening.
